units.function: Shared CLI tests for profile/context resolution, authentication and API-base precedence, company requirement, attachment MIME inference and dynamic API path construction.
units.dependencyDirection: Calls production context, credential-store and common command helpers against temporary files and environment variables; it does not execute HTTP or server authorization.
units.keyDataModels: Versioned CLI profile, API base, company ID, API-key source, authSource discriminator, filename extension and tagged-template URL path.
units.lifecycle: Writes profiles/config/auth fixtures, resolves precedence variants, infers allowlisted MIME types, percent-encodes path segments and rejects blank dynamic IDs.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 10/10. Path encoding/blank rejection and explicit precedence are strong; stored-credential fallback, origin validation, credential audience/company binding, malformed files, permissions/atomicity, content sniffing and cleanup are missing.
units.designRationale: Centralize CLI defaults and eliminate repeated unsafe URL concatenation and attachment-type guessing across commands.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs generated, tenant-aware clients whose credentials, deployment origin and dynamic identifiers cannot be confused across managed-cloud and self-hosted profiles.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the tagged path builder and table-driven precedence tests. Replace manual MIME duplication with generated/shared policy; require canonical trusted origins and credential audience/company validation, prefer env/SecretStore over argv bearer input, and add stored-fallback, corruption, atomic-write and cleanup coverage.
units.responsibilityConflict: A present company ID and bearer token do not prove membership or action accountability; every effect still needs server-side company/audience checks and responsibility evidence.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 10 passed via existing local binary
